defense_news.title: France experiments with smaller tank units to evade drone attacks
defense_news.summary: French Army commanders want to know if dispersed “Lego bricks” of Leclerc tanks and support vehicles can make themselves uninteresting to adversaries.

defense_news.title: US Navy, Boeing ink first MQ-25A Stingray production contract
defense_news.summary: The U.S. Navy awarded a $562 million fixed-price incentive contract to Boeing on Monday to start Lot 1 Low Rate Initial Production of the MQ-25A Stingray.

defense_news.title: US Air Force secretary reveals deployment of on-orbit space control weapons
defense_news.summary: Secretary of the Air Force Troy Meink revealed that the service deployed on-orbit space control weapons but did not offer details on the type of weapon.

defense_news.title: ‘It’s not science fiction’: US Air Force must build trust in AI, says expert
defense_news.summary: The military must work on how to combat fast and reckless enemy AI agents that don’t necessarily operate with the same oversight, according to experts.
